root_cause.mechanism: exit_manager.ExitState.from_entry resolves stop_mode='structure' only when trigger_level is not None. vwap_continuation is a continuation setup with trigger_level ALWAYS None -> the structure stop is a guaranteed no-op -> every position falls back to the raw -6% premium stop on every arm.
root_cause.code_ref: automation/state/fleet/exit_manager.py :: resolved_structure = (shape_mode=='structure' and bool(structure_stop_enabled) and trigger_level is not None)
root_cause.provenance_gap: the -0.06/+0.40 shape was ratified on n=149 trades over ~340 days (~0.44/day = at most ONE entry/day, no re-entry structure in the sim). It now runs at up to 5 entries/day.

control_arm_is_a_coinflip.finding: risky-1's +$640 winner survived its -6% stop by 0.34 CENTS
control_arm_is_a_coinflip.implication: risky-1's entire vwap edge over risky-3 was ~7 cents of entry fill luck. Do not build doctrine on this comparison.

counterfactual_tier1_exact.method: cooldown applied as an EXACT filter over REAL broker round trips; can only REMOVE a real entry, never invent one; conservative by construction. entry-anchored and exit-anchored give identical cells.

generalisation.proxy_disclosure: the 391-day population CANNOT answer this: vwap_continuation was import-dead until FIX2 and traded live for the FIRST time today (zero historical live sequences), and the 391-day backtest population is 1-entry-per-day by construction. Closest available proxy = every same-arm/same-day/same-setup repeat-entry sequence in the 24-day REAL engine-fill history 2026-06-26..2026-08-04.
generalisation.reading: non-monotonic across the grid (5 bad, 10 neutral, 15 bad, 30 good). A genuine effect would not zig-zag. The only positive cell is +$149 over 24 days = +$6/day, inside noise. Positive-skew shape: save ~$37/day over 23 ordinary days, forfeit ~$900 on the one trend day. Sample contains exactly ONE trend day so expectation is not estimable.

reasons: trigger count wrong and never checked: reported 7 entries, 4 were placed; placement.placed sits in the SAME row as the action field and was not read (verification error, not judgment)

decision statistic structurally biased: realized P&L at minute 11 is censored and the censoring correlates with outcome sign - losers resolve in <2 min and print, winners are still open and contribute nothing
proposed action did not follow from the diagnosis: RUN_VWAP=False disarms the ENTRY producer for a pathology whose mechanism is the EXIT

retraction.detail: retracted on the same censored 11-minute window that produced the alarm, with no new evidence acquired; both draws came from the same biased sample and the second happened to land correctly. Stated no threshold, so it left nothing behind for a future session.
retraction.aphorism: a coin that lands heads is not a decision procedure

judgment_audit.what_was_correct: did not act mid-session; Rule 9 held. The gap is that Rule 9 stopped the ACTION but not the CONCLUSION, and a stated conclusion is what a later session acts on.
judgment_audit.net: alarm wrong, retraction right, neither earned; the producing process is unchanged and will fire again on the next fast-loss cluster

reconciliation.note: both real; delta is fee/accounting treatment, not a trade discrepancy. All five arms flat at the close - confirmed.
